profile.headline: Systems Software Engineer with extensive Linux and Windows Kernel/User Mode experience in system agents, security, storage, networking, observability.
profile.summary:
Senior Systems Software Engineer | Linux & Windows Internals | Security, Storage, Networking, Embedded Systems

Senior systems software engineer with deep expertise in Linux and Windows kernel and user-mode development. Specializes in secure, high-performance system software across storage, networking, and embedded platforms. Known for delivering robust solutions from architecture through deployment and long-term maintenance.

Trusted to build production-grade systems that balance security, performance, and cross-platform compatibility under real-world constraints.

Key strengths:
- Linux agent development with persistent configuration, cross-distro abstraction, robust packaging, and upgrade reliability
- Low-level systems programming across Linux and Windows platforms with a strong focus on portability and system performance
- OS and kernel internals expertise, including system hardening and mitigation of sophisticated threat vectors
- Security certification readiness and compliance, including FIPS 140, UPAL/DODIN, and Common Criteria processes
- Runtime monitoring and policy enforcement using eBPF, LSM, auditd, and other telemetry mechanisms
- High-performance, multithreaded application design using concurrency models optimized for low-latency and high-throughput environments
- Ownership of full product lifecycle: concept, implementation, incremental delivery, QA collaboration, and production support
- Strong diagnostics and debugging capabilities, using kernel debuggers, performance profilers, and custom tools
Deep architecture knowledge of x86/x86_64, with experience spanning embedded systems to enterprise-class servers

Focused on building secure, maintainable, and scalable software that meets real-world reliability and performance demands. Brings a delivery-oriented mindset to environments that require technical depth, adaptability, and cross-functional collaboration.
